Reason: Scimitar syndrome is characterized by partial anomalous pulmonary venous return where a curvilinear shadow (the "scimitar sign") descends from the right lung to the inferior vena cava or right atrium; the provided images show arrows pointing to such vertical/curvilinear vascular shadows in the right hemithorax, consistent with aberrant venous drainage.
